text: {"lessons":["I sold Stock A twice at sizable gains, so I should check that profit-taking serves my portfolio plan rather than simply feeling good about locking in gains.","Because losses bother me more than gains please me and admitting a mistake is painful, I should avoid letting those feelings dictate whether I hold or sell.","Past price changes do not predict future moves; I should base decisions on current risk, diversification, and my long-term plan, not recent performance."]}
